caption: Bossche Broek, 's-Hertogenbosch
composition: Wet meadows from the Dommel dike, with a distant cathedral spire · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the dike along the Dommel, wet meadows and reeds of the Bossche Broek fill the foreground. Far off, the tall Gothic spire of St John's rises over the city. The sky is clear, about 12.3°C, with wind near 11.9 km/h. This is the marsh viewpoint. The cathedral close remains a separate scene. No chapel sculpture is the subject.
